section.sectionSummaryBrief: On the third of Kislev, he writes again regarding the parchment for the Sefer Torah.
section.t: However, on the third of Kislev he writes to him again:

section.sectionSummaryBrief: He notes that the parchment will be expensive, so they plan to prepare it locally.
section.t: "Regarding the parchment for the Sefer Torah, it will indeed be expensive, so we intend to do this here."

section.sectionSummaryBrief: They obtained the parchment in the United States despite wartime difficulties, and after beginning the writing, he turned to Rabbi Eliyahu Nachum Shklier.
section.t: The parchment, however, they obtained in the United States,
despite the difficulties in obtaining parchment at that time,
because most hides were taken at that time by the government
And after the beginning of the writing, he turned regarding this matter,
to the honorable Rabbi Eliyahu Nachum Shklier.
